players.product: photonic quantum systems built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) chips

quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc 10-Q (in thousands): Q2 2026 gross loss was $(1,166) on revenue of $5,551, a gross margin of -21% (43% a year earlier); first-half revenue was $9,242 and gross margin -20%. Inventory rose to $12,837 from $352 at December 31, 2025 and deferred revenue to $3,774 from $395; first-half capital expenditures were $4.5 million. For certain photonic integrated circuits and related III-V components there are very few qualified suppliers, in some cases a single source. A complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey alleges omissions and misrepresentations related to Quad M, QPhoton, NASA, millionways and the TFLN foundry and seeks unspecified damages; QCi and its board dispute the allegations and intend to defend vigorously.
